thread:
emma: Quick heads-up — TrustedPath (AcmeFin) POC kickoff scheduled Mon 10am PT. Need to lock down final RFI answers, EU data residency note, and pricing tiers for a 4-week POC. I uploaded the RFI draft (rfi_trustedpath_v2.pdf) to Drive. :paperclip:

raj: I can own the security questionnaire sections: KMS/HSM, network isolation, and failover. Do they need FedRAMP wording or stick with SOC2/ISO?

emma: Stick with SOC2 + ISO for now. They did ask about FIPS-compliant KMS for private deployments — call that out as "Available via Private + HSM integration."

sally: I'll draft the pricing matrix and the POC acceptance criteria. Quick question: price POC as reserved capacity or usage-based with a minimum? Marcus — any precedent?

marcus: For similar finance customers we propose hybrid: 1-month reserved window (committed GPU) + overage at hosted rates. Recommend a 50% discount on the reserved commit if they convert to a 12‑month Dedicated contract.

raj: Network/topology snippet I'll include in the RFI attachments (minimal config example):
```yaml
vpc_peering: true
private_subnets:
  - 10.0.1.0/24
  - 10.0.2.0/24
kms: customer_managed
hsm: optional
egress_restrictions: true
```

emma: Add our DPA blurb (EU residency + SCC fallback). DPA link: https://redwood.example.com/dpa

raj: Also note: we support active-passive multi-region routing for Dedicated; fallback to compatible hosted model variants if capacity constrained. I'll add the model-variant fallback line.

sally: Uploaded pricing draft: Drive/TrustedPath/price_matrix_v3.xlsx. Proposed POC tiers: Starter (2x A10 equiv) = $6k/week reserved, Scale (4x A10 equiv) = $11k/week, Add-on: HSM+KMS integration one-time $8k. Thoughts?

emma: Looks fine. Add a clause: if they sign enterprise within 30 days we convert unused POC reserved fees to a 3‑month trial credit. Helps close.

marcus: I'll confirm conversion-credit language with legal and loop them in once pricing is final.

ops-bot: Deployment checklist created: https://tasks.example.com/TP-POC-231. Items: infra prep, secrets, audit logs enabled, perf baseline run, smoke tests. ETA 48h once NDA signed.

raj: For attachments I'll include: network diagram PDF, the YAML snippet above, SOC2 attestation link, DPA link, and a short POC runbook that states support SLA (business hours 9-5) and on-call escalation path.

emma: Acceptance criteria we should use: latency SLO p95 < 120ms generation, throughput sustained 100 req/min, and quality gate — <3% regression on their eval set. Sally, attach the eval template.

sally: Will do. Also proposing a short success checklist for POC sign-off: 1) infra smoke tests green, 2) perf baseline achieved, 3) one integration flow validated, 4) eval metrics within threshold, 5) support handover document delivered.

emma: Great. Action items: raj — finalize security answers by EOD Thu; sally — finalize pricing + acceptance criteria by Fri AM; marcus — confirm conversion credit with legal. I'll send the POC kickoff invite and share Drive links with the AcmeFin team. :rocket:

marcus: Ping me if legal needs specific contract language early. I can fast-track a redline.

raj: Noted. I'll embed the topology diagram and include a brief note about egress control (NAT + firewall rules) and audit logging for all customer-managed subnets.

emma: Thanks everyone. If anything slips raise here so we can re-prioritize before the Monday kickoff.
